children: Cuprina Holdings (Cayman) Limited closed a public offering of 4,322,489 Class A shares at $1.15, raising approximately $4.97M gross. The underwriter has a 45-day option for up to 648,373 additional shares, which would bring gross proceeds to about $5.72M if exercised.
Adds cash for operations and growth; pricing signals current market demand for shares.
Increases float and dilutes existing holders; supply can pressure near-term price.
Greenshoe could add ~$0.75M gross; may support aftermarket stabilization.
Funds targeted to growth initiatives and liquidity rather than debt repayment.
Registered follow-on; removes resale overhang risk tied to unregistered shares.

This follow-on raise follows recent FDA 510(k) clearance and signals an early-stage capital build for growth. A full greenshoe exercise, pipeline milestones, or revenue traction from wound-care products would turn this into a stronger catalyst.
